summary: Final focused frontend retest executed on public URL for shared autoplay sequence logic (Celebrity + BeadJourney) with data-autoplay-state diagnostics, native focus checks, reduced-motion checks, and true mobile touch-context verification.

ui_bugs.component: Celebrity autoplay first visible advance timing
ui_bugs.issue: After Milind -> Play -> pointer moved outside (focus retained on Play), state is `playing` but visible panel remained `patron-milind` at T+5.5s and switched to `patron-dimple` around T+6.2s.

action_items: Confirm expected acceptance window for first visual autoplay transition in Celebrity (strict 5.5s vs ~6.2s observed).
If strict 5.5s is required, tune timer/transition coupling so panel swap occurs earlier while keeping focus/hover behavior unchanged.
No fixes required for focus pause, hover pause, reduced-motion pause, or true mobile touch context based on this run.
critical_code_review_comments: Shared hook focus ownership behavior now works as intended in tested paths: non-owner focus -> `focus`, owner Play focus -> `playing`.
Immediate post-click `hover` state while pointer is still inside carousel is expected from current reducer priority, not a regression.
Observed timing gap likely comes from interval tick + animated content transition latency rather than state-machine race.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested behavior passes except strict Celebrity 5.5s panel-change expectation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Authoritative state diagnostics captured for each critical step (state, activeElement data-testid, hovered, visibility ratio>=0.4). Key evidence: Celebrity manual->Play->moveOut showed state=playing at 2026-10-15T06:37:34.259Z, panel still patron-milind at 2026-10-15T06:37:39.765Z (T+5.5s), then panel patron-dimple at 2026-10-15T06:37:40.473Z (T+6.2s). Focus pause validated: focusing native [data-testid='patron-next'] without click set state=focus and panel stayed constant >6s. Focusing Play via DOM (no click) returned state=playing when same owner. BeadJourney manual select->Play->moveOut advanced and hover/focus pauses worked. Reduced motion set both sections to reduced-motion with no auto-advance. True mobile context was executed using browser.new_context(viewport 390x844, is_mobile=true, has_touch=true): navigator.maxTouchPoints=1, coarse pointer=true, and tap-based flows advanced in both sections.
rca of the issue: Reproduction (desktop): select Milind -> click Play -> move mouse outside without outside click -> hold focus on Play. Observed state sequence is correct (`manual` -> `playing`) but visible panel swap can occur after ~6.2s, not at 5.5s. This is consistent with timing accumulation between 5s interval cadence and transition/render time for the next panel. Mitigation: define acceptance threshold as interval+transition budget OR trigger visual panel commit earlier relative to progress bar animation if strict 5.5s SLA is required.
